desc.description: Description of the service displayed in logs and status messages.

name.description: The base name of the daemon/process.

mailto.description: Email address to send RAID status change notifications to.

period.description: Seconds between each RAID status check.

remind.description: Seconds between each reminder email if the RAID is still in a bad state.

run_daemon.description: Whether to run the daemon. Set to 'no' to disable.

id.description: Index of the MPT RAID controller to monitor.
